INSERT INTO one.episode (owner, id, status, retention_class, region, record_key_id, dek_id,
                                      ciphertext, ciphertext_len, promise_version)
             SELECT $1, $2, 'active', $3, a.region, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8
               FROM one.account a WHERE a.owner = $1
